skill_name: Describe the different pieces of hardware on a computer.
workflow: The hardware components of a computer include the motherboard, Central Processing Unit (CPU), Random Access Memory (RAM), hard drive, graphics processing unit (GPU), power supply, and network interface card. The motherboard is the main circuit board of the computer. It connects all of the hardware including the CPU, RAM, hard drive, and other components. The CPU processes data from the RAM. The hard drive stores data and programs that the computer uses. The GPU processes graphics-intensive tasks
